questions.q: Which recovery site requires installing hardware in addition to restoring data?
questions.explain: A cold site only provides the facility and utilities; both hardware and data must be installed.

questions.q: A company accepts losing up to 15 minutes of transactions. Which metric does this describe?
questions.explain: Acceptable data loss is RPO. RTO describes the acceptable duration of service interruption.

questions.q: Which measure best protects backups against ransomware that deletes copies?
questions.explain: An immutable copy cannot be modified or deleted, even with administrator privileges.

questions.q: Which elements represent redundancy? (Select all that apply)
questions.explain: An air-gap is separation, not redundancy. The other three eliminate a single point of failure.

questions.q: A critical service has an RTO of 2 hours but depends on the network, which has an RTO of 6 hours. What is the realistic RTO?
questions.explain: Recovery cannot be faster than the slowest dependency: the network imposes 6 hours.

questions.q: Which metric measures the reliability of a piece of equipment?
questions.explain: MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) measures the average time between failures. MTTR measures repair time.
